posts.headline: Trump Announces 10% Global Tariff on All Imports
posts.body: President Trump signed a decree imposing a universal 10% tariff on all imported goods, on top of existing trade measures. The announcement came late Friday and could face years of legal challenges. Markets reacted with caution as investors weighed the impact on global trade.

posts.headline: Vanda Pharmaceuticals Gains on FDA Approval News
posts.body: Vanda Pharmaceuticals saw gains in after-hours trading following approval news. The stock was among the gappers mentioned in after-hours trading along with $NCI, $SGN, $PBM, and $SPPL.

posts.headline: NVIDIA Attracts Bearish Options Flow
posts.body: NVIDIA and Tesla attracted the most bearish options flow today, signaling continued institutional caution toward megacap tech names. The heavy put activity comes amid broader market uncertainty around tariffs and economic policy.

posts.headline: Rocket Companies Highlights Week's Best Day Trade
posts.body: Rocket Companies (RKT) was the standout day trade this week, hitting as a day trade on Wednesday and as a swing on Thursday. AlertsAndNews reported 100% win rate on swings this month.

posts.headline: Tesla Sees Heavy Bearish Options Activity
posts.body: Tesla joined NVIDIA in attracting significant bearish options flow today. Institutional traders remain cautious on the electric vehicle maker amid ongoing market volatility and macro economic uncertainties.
